tools.name: dokun_list_customers
tools.description: List the loyalty-card customers of your Dokun business, newest first. Returns at most 200 records (the 200 most recent sign-ups); there is no pagination. Each record has name, email, created_at and marketing_consent_at (null when marketing consent was not given). The emails are card-holder personal

tools.name: dokun_add_stamp
tools.description: Add stamps to a loyalty card. This changes the card balance and can fire a stamp webhook; it cannot be undone through this tool. serial is the card serial number or the full QR text scanned at the counter (sent as is). delta is the number of stamps to add (default 1). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dokun_list_customers · Private data: dokun_list_customers · Public sink: dokun_list_customers, dokun_add_stamp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dokun_list_customers · Private data: dokun_list_customers · Public sink: dokun_list_customers, dokun_add_stamp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
